fields.description: Four parts: the answer first, one real example, the catch said plainly, then the takeaway. Write DocType names in backticks, like `Sales Invoice`.
fields.label: Article

fields.description: Filled from the panels' text when the part has panels.
fields.label: Article

fields.description: One sentence, ideally under 12 words. No unchecked numbers.
fields.label: Takeaway

fields.description: Optional. Without it the page uses its own image if one was generated, otherwise the series image.
fields.label: Share image (1200 x 630)

fields.description: Set automatically. While a part is unpublished, /explainers/<slug>?preview=<key> shows it to anyone with the link. It is never listed or indexed.
fields.label: Preview key

fields.description: Panel, text, panel, text (D-157). When panels are filled, the page shows them instead of the single panel and article, and fills the asker, question, Deepak pose and article for the card and feed.

fields.description: One line, so a reader who lands here cold can follow.
fields.label: So far
